subject: Aligning demo: use case, volume, and calendar
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@sparrowhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo request from self-serve signup — a few quick questions before we book

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for signing up and requesting a demo — saw your note from the self-serve flow and wanted to ask a few quick questions so we tailor the session. If you can reply inline that’s perfect.

Quick questions:
- Primary use case: is this for clinical note summarization, patient triage, internal knowledge search, or something else?
- Monthly volume: approximate tokens / API calls per month (ballpark is fine).
- Concurrency: any peak realtime needs (concurrent sessions/users)?
- Timeline: when do you want to have a pilot / POC live?
- Data sensitivity: will you be sending PHI? Any HIPAA needs or SOC 2 requirements we should prep for?
- Success metrics: latency targets or cost goals we should know about?

Suggested next steps: if you want a quick intro demo we can do 30 minutes. My Calendly link: https://calendly.com/redwood-irene/30min — I also included Ben (SE) to run through technical fit if helpful.

Attachments: I attached a short demo deck and an example security questionnaire we often prefill for prospects — feel free to add any internal notes.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: sparrow-security-questions.docx (docx)]
From: Jordan Patel <jordan.patel@sparrowhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Demo request from self-serve signup — a few quick questions before we book

Hi Irene — thanks for the quick follow-up. Answers inline below.

> Primary use case: is this for clinical note summarization, patient triage, internal knowledge search, or something else?
We’re primarily focused on clinical note summarization to speed charting for our clinicians, with a secondary use of extracting structured medication lists for billing reconciliation.

> Monthly volume: approximate tokens / API calls per month (ballpark is fine).
We’re estimating ~6M tokens/month to start (50k notes, avg ~120 tokens extracted/transformed per call). We could double that within 6 months if pilot goes well.

> Concurrency: any peak realtime needs (concurrent sessions/users)?
Peak concurrency ~15 concurrent users at busiest times (mostly 1–2s generation per note ideally).

> Timeline: when do you want to have a pilot / POC live?
Target pilot launch: mid-October (around 2026-10-15). We'd like a 6–8 week POC with integration to our sandbox.

> Data sensitivity: will you be sending PHI? Any HIPAA needs or SOC 2 requirements we should prep for?
Yes — PHI will be involved. We need to understand Redwood’s Private deployment options and SOC 2 scope.

> Success metrics: latency targets or cost goals we should know about?
Latency: under 2.5s per note average. Cost: we’re trying to keep per-note cost under $0.02 if possible for the pilot.

Proposed time: I’m available Thurs 8/20 14:00–16:00 PT or Fri 8/21 09:00–11:00 PT.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Patel
Product Manager, Sparrow Health
jordan.patel@sparrowhealth.com

Awesome — thanks Jordan, this is super helpful.

Ben and Marissa — looping you both in: Ben can cover architecture, latency and quantization options; Marissa can speak to pilot pricing and Dedicated/Private timelines.

Jordan — we can do Thursday 8/20 at 14:30 PT (45 minutes) to walk through a short demo and then map next steps for a private deployment POC. Proposed agenda:
- 10m: introductions + goals
- 15m: demo focused on summarization and extraction (Ben)
- 10m: HIPAA/SOC2 and deployment options (Marissa)
- 10m: next steps + success metrics and timeline

I attached an initial security questionnaire with a couple of answers filled in based on typical healthcare pilots — Marissa will follow up with more details on SOC2 evidence and Private deployment cadence.

If that slot works I’ll send a calendar invite with a short discovery doc attached so your engineering lead can add specifics. Otherwise, here are alternatives: Fri 8/21 09:30 PT or Mon 8/24 11:00 PT.

Calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-irene/30min (we’ll also send a direct invite once you confirm).

Thanks — Irene
